_comment: Cursor environment.json — defines the cloud environment for Background Agents. Commit this file to the repository root as .cursor/environment.json. Agents run in ephemeral containers using this spec.

env._comment: Non-secret environment variables only. Do NOT put credentials, API keys, or tokens here — use the 'secrets' block.

secrets._comment: References to encrypted secrets stored in Cursor KMS. Configure secret values in Settings → Background Agents → Secrets. Keys here are the secret names; Cursor injects them as environment variables at runtime.

_security_notes: Never put API keys, tokens, passwords, or credentials in the 'env' block — they will be visible to anyone with repo read access.
Use the 'secrets' block for all sensitive values. Cursor KMS encrypts them at rest and injects them at runtime.
Pin the baseImage to a specific digest (e.g., ghcr.io/cursor-images/node-20@sha256:...) for supply-chain security.
The persistedDirectories list controls what is cached between agent runs. Review it to avoid unintentionally caching sensitive files.
This file should be reviewed before merging — changes to it modify the agent execution environment.
